description: This Java source file defines the ProductService class, providing transactional methods for managing Product entities including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products within a backend API.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Service class managing product data with transactional boundaries, providing core CRUD operations.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all products as ProductResponse DTOs.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID, throwing ProductNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product from a ProductRequest DTO and returns the created product as a ProductResponse DTO.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with data from ProductRequest, returning the updated ProductResponse.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID, throwing ProductNotFoundException if the product does not exist.
